recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Do not restore the STU3 literal list or remove later summary flags while reconciling FHIR-13855; revisit only if SD opens a new current-version issue to redefine the R6 Composition summary set.
issue_request: FHIR-13855 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 and asked to review Composition _summary behavior against DocumentReference FHIR-12949. Its final 2018 disposition kept summary flags on status, type, subject, author, title, event, identifier/masterIdentifier, confidentiality, encounter, date, and custodian, and removed flags from non-Composition content fields, attester and children, relatesTo, section.author, and section.mode.
initial_application: The issue was applied by git-svn commit 1ed44d057f3aa04de302c0203b78b3c9dce9fd66 (svn revision 14131), which changed source/composition/composition-spreadsheet.xml and removed summary markers from attester, attester children, relatesTo, relatesTo children, section.mode, and section.author-related rows. The old spreadsheet source was later replaced by source/composition/structuredefinition-Composition.xml, where the same outcome is preserved.
additional_context: Composition is active in the current build via source/fhir.ini. Later resource evolution explains differences from the STU3 list: FHIR-17555 renamed Composition.class to category, Composition.confidentiality was removed in favor of Bundle.meta.security, section.mode was removed, and newer metadata/classification elements have their own later summary flags. Zulip implementation discussion records that event.detail was intentionally left as-is and that class/category should be summary.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source already has summary flags on the current counterparts of the requested kept elements and no summary flag on the requested removals that still exist; removed or renamed STU3 elements are accounted for by later source history.
